title: Lower Power: Squat
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Tri-Planar Ankle × 8/side · Inchworm Walk × 4 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side · A-skip 2 × 20 yd · B-skip 2 × 20 yd
jumps: Back Squat 3 @ RPE 7, fast → Hurdle Hops 5 → Trap Bar Jump 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Power wk 1: no tempo, lighter bar, every rep max speed · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · no hurdles? Tuck jumps
strength: Shoulders on the bench, drive hard
Long hamstring, push the heel down
note: Power block starts: no tempo, lighter heavy step. Move the bar fast, then jump.
